title: saveCookie
description: Save a specific browser cookie to a file or environment variable for later reuse.

anyOf.title: Cookie name
anyOf.description: A cookie file path ending in `.txt`, or a cookie name. `session.txt` saves the cookie named `session` to `session.txt` in `outputDir`. Any other value saves the cookie with that name to the environment variable of the same name.

name.title: Cookie name
name.description: Name of the specific cookie to save.

variable.title: Environment variable name
variable.description: Environment variable name to store the cookie as JSON string. To read it later as `$NAME`, use only letters, digits, and underscores.

path.title: Cookie file path
path.description: File path to save the cookie, in Netscape cookie format. A relative path resolves against `directory`, or against `outputDir` when `directory` is omitted.

directory.title: Directory path
directory.description: Directory to save the cookie file in. A relative directory resolves against the spec file. Omit it to save under `outputDir`.

overwrite.title: Overwrite existing file
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing cookie file.

domain.title: Cookie domain
domain.description: Specific domain to filter the cookie by (optional).
